description: Build a verified Volume > Level keyframe curve for one audio clip. Ducking-window times are relative to that clip's start; overlapping or out-of-range windows are rejected before any keyframe write.

base_db.description: Normal clip level in dB (defaults to 0).

ducking_windows.description: Non-overlapping windows during which this clip should be quieter.

ducked_db.description: Level during the window, in dB.

end_seconds.description: Window end, relative to clip start.

start_seconds.description: Window start, relative to clip start.

fade_seconds.description: Fade length on each side of a window in seconds (defaults to 0.2).

name: setup_ducking

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Setup Ducking
